description.describe_ch: 內容包含函數極限，導數，導函數，微分公式，鏈鎖律，隱微分，高階導數，線性近似與微分量，極大和極小值，導數與函數圖形之關係，無窮極限，水平漸近線，反導數，定積分，微積分基本定理，不定積分，代換法，曲線所圍之區域面積，自然對數函數，自然指數函數，一般對數與指數函數，反三角函數，並探討相關應用。
description.describe_eh: Topics include the Limit of a Function, Derivatives, Differentiation Formula, the Chain Rule, Implicit Differentiation, Higher Derivatives, Linear Approximation, Maximum and Minimum Values, the Definite Integral, the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus, Indefinite Integrals, the Substitution Rule, Logarithmic and Exponential Functions, Inverse Trigonometric Functions and their applications.

targets.describe_ch: 了解函數在有限值與在正、負無限大的極限意義和極限不存在時的可能現象。
targets.describe_en: Understand the limits of functions at a finite value, the limits of functions at infinity, horizontal asymptotes and vertical asymptotes.

targets.describe_ch: 能應用極限的四則運算定理、夾擠定理、合成運算定理、計算函數的極限值。
targets.describe_en: Be able to compute the limit of a function by applying properties of the limit such as the basic properties, the squeeze theorem and the composite function theorem

targets.describe_ch: 了解函數的連續性意義和連續性與極限概念的關係。
targets.describe_en: Comprehend the concept of a continuous function and its relationship with the limit

targets.describe_ch: 了解連續函數的中間值定理以及用數值方法求方程式根之應用。
targets.describe_en: Understand the intermediate value theorem and its application for solving equations by numerical method

targets.describe_ch: 了解導函數的意義並知道函數的可微性與連續性間之關係。
targets.describe_en: Realize the definition of derivative of a function and understand the sufficient/necessary condition between differentiability and continuity

targets.describe_ch: .認識多項式、對數、指數、三角、反三角、合成、隱函數之導函數的求法。
targets.describe_en: Be able to find the derivatives of polynomial, logarithmic, exponential, trigonometric and inverse trigonometric functions. Be able to perform differentiation using chain rule as well as the implicit differentiations.

targets.describe_ch: 能應用導數判定函數的單調性與凹性並利用漸近線協助繪製函數圖形。
targets.describe_en: Be able to apply the first and second derivative tests to analyze the monotonicity and concavity of a function. Be able to use these properties along with its asymptotes to sketch the graph of a function

targets.describe_ch: 能利用導數判定函數的極值及其在工程、商業和管理方面的應用。
targets.describe_en: Understand the use of the first derivative test for local extrema and its application in engineering, business, and management

targets.describe_ch: 了解L'H pital's Rule的意義並能利用其原理求不定型
targets.describe_en: Be able to compute limits of indeterminate forms, such as  , by using L'H pital's rule

targets.describe_ch: 了解定積分與不定積分的概念與基本性質。
targets.describe_en: Be able to grasp the concept of the definite integral and the indefinite integral and understand their basic properties

targets.describe_ch: 能利用微積分基本定理求積分。
targets.describe_en: Be able to use the fundamental theorem of Calculus to compute definite integrals

targets.describe_ch: 能利用代換積分法求反導函數與定積分。
targets.describe_en: Be able to use the method of substitution to compute definite integrals as well as indefinite integrals

targets.describe_ch: 能利用定積分求曲線間區域的面積。
targets.describe_en: Be able to use a definite integral to obtain the area of the region bounded a curve and the  axis and that between two curves.

targets.describe_ch: 認識雙曲函數及其導函數的求法。
targets.describe_en: Be able to grasp the definitions of hyperbolic functions and differentiate an expression involving hyperbolic functions.

readings.tpc_book: ilearn 線上數位教材與講義及練習題

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: Functions and Their Graphs; Combining Functions; Limit of a Function and Limit Laws
Limits Involving Infinity; Asymptotes of Graphs; Tangents and the Derivative at a Point
The Derivative as a Function; Differentiation Rules
Derivatives of Trigonometric Functions; The Chain Rule
Implicit Differentiation; Inverse Functions; Derivatives of Inverse Functions
Linearization and Differentials; Extreme Values of Functions; The Mean Value Theorem
Monotonic Functions and the First Derivative Test; Concavity and Curve Sketching
Antiderivatives; Indefinite Integrals and the Substitution Method
The Definite Integral; The Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
Definite Integral Substitutions and the Area Between Curves
